cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a GIS Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:

Strong written and oral communication skills
Attention to detail, customer focus, teamwork, and interpersonal skills
Ability to transition between tasks and complete projects in a timely manner
Geographic Information Science Certificate or equivalent
Preferred Requirements
General knowledge of Maximo Asset Management System
Experience with subsurface utility mapping

Scope of Services:
Perform a wide variety of analytical and geoprocessing functions to create, maintain and retrieve data
Monitor GIS environment – GIS Enterprise Portal (ArcGIS Server/Portal), ArcGIS Online, and SQL Relational database
Develop GIS solutions using ArcGIS software to enhance existing and future GIS projects
Responsible for meeting with the business and evaluating project/request requirements and providing guidance/solutions accordingly
Develop geographic databases, including designs and models. Comprehensive working knowledge of database concepts (including SQL DB)
Assist with field data collection using ArcGIS Survey123 and ArcGIS Collector
Assist with training and technical support of end users and stakeholders
cond_0147.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Geography, Geographic Information Systems, Computer Science, or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience
Around 5 years of experience as a GIS Analyst working with the ESRI Product suite, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Around 5 years of experience with Geodatabase management procedures and relational databases
Around 3 years of experience with GIS programming/scripting languages (Python, SQL)
Around 3 years of experience with Autodesk's AutoCAD, BIM, and conversion into GIS
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally
Attention to detail, customer focus, teamwork, and interpersonal skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and transition between projects as needed
Geographic Information Science Certificate or equivalent, or willingness to obtain
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with Maximo Asset Management System
Experience with subsurface utility mapping
Experience with interior building mapping and wayfinding
Experience working with 3D GIS software (ArcScene)
